FULL TEXT:
Press News
Applications are invited from eligible candidates for the temporary
engagement of 20 Support Persons on an honorarium basis to provide necessary
support and guidance to children affected by sexual offences under the Protection
of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012, during investigation and
court proceedings. The engagement will be purely temporary.
Education Details Honorarium No. of Vacancies
Any person with a Post Graduate Degree in
Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psychology,
Child Development or any other relevant field
related to child welfare, health or education
or a graduate with a minimum of 3 years’
experience in child education, development,
health or protection issues.
Rs.10,000/-
Per Case in 4
Instalments
20
Address : District Child Protection Officer,
District Child Protection Unit,
Room No. F0-06, Ground Floor, F-Block,
New District Collectorate Campus,
Chengalpattu - 603 111.
Contact No : 6382613163
The duly completed application form, along with copies of all relevant
certificates, including educational qualification certificates, a recent photograph
and experience certificates, must reach the above-mentioned office address
between 16/10/2026 and 30/10/ 2026, on or before 5:45 PM.
The application form can be downloaded from the official website:
http://chengalpattu.nic.in. The completed application, along with photocopies of
the relevant supporting documents, must be sent by direct or post or courier so
as to reach the above-mentioned address within the stipulated deadline.
Applications that are incomplete or submitted without the required
supporting documents will be rejected without prior notice. No correspondence
regarding such rejections will be entertained.
District Collector / Chairman,
District Child Protection Unit,
Chengalpattu.
